summary: The document is a fact sheet titled 'Infosys Consolidated Financial Data - Third Quarter, Fiscal 2026,' presenting financial metrics and growth data for the company. It includes revenue growth figures for Q3 2026, highlighting a 0.6% quarter-on-quarter and 1.7% year-on-year growth. The sheet details revenues by business segments, with financial services leading at 28.2% as of December 31, 2025. It also breaks down revenues by client geography, showing North America as the largest contributor at 55.9%. Client data indicates a total of 1,949 active clients by the end of 2025, with significant contributions from top clients. The document provides insights into operating margins, EPS increases, and free cash flow, reflecting the company's financial health and market performance.
